facts.fact: 1943 年墨西哥城，身无分文的 Ulises 要在 Monclova 寡妇与 Veracruz 小镇 Puerco Ahogado 的老处女之间做选择
facts.anchor: He was going to make a choice, either the widow from Mon-clova or the spinster from that town in Veracruz

facts.fact: 父亲死后三年他没有继承父亲的犯罪天赋，积蓄被父亲的病掏空
facts.anchor: But after three years now without his father, he was rudderless, hardly able to remain afloat

facts.fact: 上一个骗局：Jalisco 寡妇 Cornelia Aguirre 的假投资被她三个儿子搅局，他只身逃走；寡妇有三个儿子，年龄八岁、六岁、四岁
facts.anchor: he had made up a pack of lies about wanting and loving children because the widow had three of them, ages eight, six, and four

facts.fact: 他把寡妇送的相机卖给皮条客 Moisés（专骗游客），并拒绝其入伙邀请
facts.anchor: He took the camera from his shoulder bag and handed it to Moisés

facts.fact: 抉择落点是钱：去 Puerco Ahogado 的火车票更便宜
facts.anchor: In the end, his decision came down to money: the ticket to Puerco Ahogado, Veracruz, was cheaper

facts.fact: 他化名 Mr. Linares 坐火车赴约；Fito 受 Miss Inclán 之命接站（车当天早晨发动不起来）；站台被吃冰淇淋的男孩弄脏米色西装
facts.anchor: Hello, sir, Miss Inclán sent me to pick you up. Sorry I’m late, the car wouldn’t start this morning

facts.fact: 先遇侄女 Inés（目光大胆、自称不是女佣），后见 Perla Inclán（鸽灰套装+银十字架），被安排进蝴蝶室
facts.anchor: Her lack of deference established her identity. This was no housemaid

facts.fact: 房客只有 Manuela、Eduviges Zorrilla 与 Nepomuceno 教授三拨；Perla 之父 Osorio Inclán 曾经营 Inclán 咖啡公司
facts.anchor: Manuela and Eduviges Zorrilla. And Professor Nepomuceno.
